dashboard.welcome: Welcome to the Fraud Detection Platform
dashboard.intro: Choose an analytical module from the sidebar to start scanning your data for signs of manipulation or fraud.

price_variance.title: Price Variance Analysis
price_variance.description: Detect cases where an employee buys the same material at a much higher price than peers, which may indicate collusion or inflated invoices.
price_variance.no_flags: No suspicious variance detected under the current criteria.

benford.title: Fake Invoices Detector — Benford's Law
benford.description: Analyzes the natural distribution of leading digits in invoice amounts. A large deviation from the expected Benford distribution may indicate fabricated figures.
benford.verdict_ok: Distribution matches Benford's Law — no strong signs of manipulation.
benford.verdict_suspicious: Large deviation from Benford's Law — manual review of invoices is recommended.

transfers.title: Suspicious Transfers Detection
transfers.description: Identify anomalous amounts that do not fit the normal spending pattern using Isolation Forest and Z-Score.

shell.title: Shell Companies Tracker
shell.description: Spot new suppliers with sudden large dealings, or whose bank account matches an employee's account.
shell.no_findings: No indicators of shell companies detected.
